metadata.title: BelgoBase - Belgian B2B Company Intelligence
metadata.description: BelgoBase helps high-value B2B teams find the right Belgian companies faster with KBO company data, NBB financial insights, and advanced filters.

hero.titleLine1: Turn Belgium into a searchable market for your next high-value clients

faq.title: Still have questions?
faq.ctaText: Book a demo to see how BelgoBase fits your Belgian targeting workflow.
faq.q1: How quickly can we get started?
faq.a1: Most teams can begin with a tailored demo and onboarding plan within days of first contact.
faq.q2: Where does the data come from?
faq.a2: BelgoBase is built on official Belgian company data from the KBO, enriched with NBB financial insights and publicly available business information where available.
faq.a3: Yes. We provide company data and general business contact information only. No personal data or LinkedIn scraping.
faq.q4: Can I choose my own criteria?
faq.a4: Yes. Filter by sector, region, legal form, company age, revenue, employee count, NACE codes, payroll signals, and more.
faq.a5: Yes. Enterprise and custom plans include official invoicing with VAT. We'll confirm billing details during onboarding.
faq.a6: Yes. Share your client list or enterprise numbers and we'll remove them from your results.
faq.a7: Your target lists can be exported in formats your team can import into most CRM systems.
faq.q8: Do you cover all of Belgium?
faq.a8: Yes. BelgoBase covers 1.9M+ Belgian companies from the official KBO foundation.
faq.q9: Can I see the platform before committing?
faq.a9: Yes. Book a demo and we'll show how your ideal Belgian segment appears inside the platform.
